Proposition

1. ch3:3.15Let $M$ be a smooth $n$-manifold, possibly with boundary, and let $p\in M$. For every smooth chart $(U,(x^i))$ containing $p$, the vectors \[ \left.\frac{\partial }{\partial x^1}\right|_p,\ldots , \left.\frac{\partial }{\partial x^n}\right|_p \] form a basis of the $n$-dimensional space $T_pM$.
